recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（CD5 對 CD7，淋巴球閘門），非形態影像；主要藍色族群同時表現 CD5 與強 CD7（約 10^2），與另一群 CD5 較弱、CD7 較弱的洋紅色族群分開，符合 T-PLL 的 CD7 強表現。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD5-PB (x-axis) versus CD7-APC700 (y-axis), gated on [Lymphs]
Dominant blue population with uniform CD5 (about 10^1) and bright CD7 (about 10^1.5 to 10^2) forming a compact cluster
Separate magenta population with dimmer CD5 and dimmer, more heterogeneous CD7
Scattered red events within and below the blue cluster
Small green CD5-negative, CD7-negative population near the origin
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD5 versus CD7 expression. The predominant population (blue) is tightly clustered and co-expresses CD5 with bright CD7, whereas a smaller magenta population shows dimmer and more heterogeneous CD5 and CD7, and a green population is double-negative. The colour legend is not shown, so population assignments are inferred from their relative size and uniformity. Retention of CD5 and bright CD7 on the dominant expanded population is characteristic of T-prolymphocytic leukemia.
